title: Banks Act Directive D5/2011 — Exemption from certain minimum disclosure requirements pertaining to branches of foreign institutions
enablingLegislation: Section 6(6)(a) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990)

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: This directive is issued by the Prudential Authority in terms of Section 6(6)(a) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Exemption from certain minimum disclosure requirements pertaining to branches of foreign institutions.

sections.heading: Application
sections.text: This directive applies to all banks, branches of foreign institutions and controlling companies registered or operating in South Africa in terms of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Exemption from certain minimum disclosure requirements pertaining to branches of foreign institutions.

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: Exemption from certain minimum disclosure requirements pertaining to branches of foreign institutions. Institutions are required to ensure compliance with the requirements set out herein. This directive remains effective as confirmed in Banks Act Circular 1 of the relevant year.
